title: Haemul Pajeon Seafood Pancake

seo.metaDescription: Learn how to make crispy, authentic Haemul Pajeon (Korean Seafood Pancake) at home with this easy-to-follow recipe. Perfect for a delicious meal!

Tips for the Crispiest Haemul Pajeon

seo.imageCaption: Enjoy a delicious, homemade Haemul Pajeon, packed with fresh seafood and a crispy texture.

description: Haemul Pajeon is a beloved Korean savory pancake, generously loaded with fresh seafood and vibrant green onions. Its distinct crispy edges and tender interior make it an irresistible appetizer or a delightful light meal. This traditional dish offers a delightful blend of textures and flavors, perfect for sharing with friends and family.

instructions.title: Prepare the Batter
instructions.text: In a large bowl, whisk together the all-purpose flour, rice flour, cold water, egg, and salt until just combined. Do not overmix; a few lumps are fine. Refrigerate for 15 minutes to allow the batter to rest.

instructions.title: Prepare Seafood and Vegetables
instructions.text: Thoroughly wash and pat dry the shrimp and squid. Chop the shrimp into bite-sized pieces and slice the squid into rings. Cut the green onions into 3-4 inch lengths and thinly slice the yellow onion.

instructions.title: Make the Dipping Sauce
instructions.text: In a small bowl, combine soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, toasted sesame seeds, and gochugaru (if using). Mix well and set aside.

instructions.title: Cook the Pancake Base
instructions.text: Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Once hot, pour about 1/3 to 1/2 of the batter into the pan, spreading it evenly to form a thin layer.

instructions.title: Add Toppings
instructions.text: Quickly arrange a generous amount of green onion pieces, sliced yellow onion, shrimp, and squid evenly over the batter. You can also add a few optional red chili slices for color and mild heat.

instructions.title: Fry Until Golden
instructions.text: Cook for 5-7 minutes until the bottom is golden brown and crispy. Drizzle another tablespoon of oil around the edges of the pancake to ensure even crisping.

instructions.title: Flip and Finish Cooking
instructions.text: Carefully flip the pancake using a wide spatula. Cook for another 5-7 minutes on the second side until golden brown and the seafood is cooked through. Repeat with remaining batter and toppings.

instructions.title: Serve Immediately
instructions.text: Transfer the Haemul Pajeon to a cutting board, slice into wedges, and serve hot with the prepared dipping sauce. Enjoy its crispy texture and rich seafood flavor.

tips: For the crispiest Pajeon, use a mix of all-purpose and rice flour, and ensure your skillet is very hot before pouring the batter. Using cold water for the batter also helps with crispiness.
Do not overcrowd the pan with too much batter or toppings; cook in batches if necessary to maintain a good temperature and achieve crispy results. A thin batter layer promotes crispiness.
Haemul Pajeon is best enjoyed immediately after cooking, while it's still warm and crispy. Serve with makgeolli (Korean rice wine) for an authentic pairing, especially on a rainy day.
